boundaries.label: Where Drenyra and Elvyra operate today

cards.title: How the stack builds
items: Each layer abstracts one concern and can operate independently
A higher layer is enabled by the layer beneath it, never by skipping one
Layer 1 is shared infrastructure: every product uses the same Fabric

cards.title: Intelligence scaling rule
items: Deterministic rules first, then small specialized models
General models only when the cheaper rungs fail
A human expert remains the top rung, never the first resort

cards.title: Command is the human layer
items: Missions, approvals, incidents and override live here
AI assists and prepares; a human authorizes; the system executes
The operating cycle is observe, understand, decide, authorize, execute, verify, learn

cards.title: Edge comes last
items: Physical devices land only after layers 1 to 4 are mature
Designed for offline operation, deferred sync and on-device inference
Today Drenyra and Elvyra stop at Command; edge is the next vertical
